pageNarrationSegments.title: Home Values
pageNarrationSegments.text: In Hancock Park and Larchmont, 90004, home prices are down 26.3% from a year ago, so buyers should compare recent sales.

pageNarrationSegments.title: Realtor Introduction
pageNarrationSegments.text: Quick note for agents: Los Angeles County is open for sponsorship. Learn more at agentsautomated.com.

pageNarrationSegments.title: Median sale prices
pageNarrationSegments.text: Median sale prices are now $1.28M, down 26.3% from a year ago and down 10% from five years ago. Buyers comparing budgets should use the latest completed sales as their reference point.

pageNarrationSegments.title: Price per square foot
pageNarrationSegments.text: Price per square foot is $759, down 7.3% from a year ago. Buyers comparing homes of similar size and condition should look closely at what those homes actually sold for.

pageNarrationSegments.title: Available homes
pageNarrationSegments.text: There are 165 homes available, up 1.9% from a year ago and up 12.2% from five years ago. Buyers have a slightly wider selection to choose from.

pageNarrationSegments.title: Median days on market
pageNarrationSegments.text: The median days on market is 60, down 11.8% from a year ago. Sellers can plan a marketing timeline around that figure, though it is not a promised sale date.

pageNarrationSegments.title: Homes sold
pageNarrationSegments.text: Homes sold total 36 in the 3 months ending October, down 26.5% from a year ago. Sellers should weigh these completed transactions when reviewing their asking price.

pageNarrationSegments.title: Sales above, at and below asking
pageNarrationSegments.text: Most homes sold below asking, more common than last year.
pageNarrationSegments.takeaway: Sales above, at and below asking

pageNarrationSegments.title: Local happenings
pageNarrationSegments.text: Los Angeles County broke ground October 3 on a reimagined Charles White Park in Altadena, with an inclusive playground designed by Disney Imagineers, a splash pad, lighted pickleball courts, a new recreation center, native shade trees, accessible walkways, a demonstration garden, and public art across the five-acre park.

pageNarrationSegments.title: Sale-to-list percentage
pageNarrationSegments.text: Homes are selling for about 3% under their final asking price. Sellers can review completed comparable sales before choosing an asking price.

pageNarrationSegments.title: Contact
pageNarrationSegments.text: Buyers can use recent completed sales to set realistic budgets, while sellers should price against final sale evidence rather than optimistic asking prices. Are you a real estate agent in Los Angeles County? Claim this county's market reports at agentsautomated.com.
